summary: Daymark displays persisted todos with title, notes, category, priority, due date, completion, and delete controls, but currently has no way to correct or update an existing task.
requirements: Users can open an existing task for editing.
Users can update the task title, notes, category, priority, and due date.
Users can save valid edits or cancel without changing the task.
A blank or whitespace-only title cannot be saved.
Saved edits persist through the existing localStorage mechanism and existing task interactions continue to work.
constraints: Use the existing React state and localStorage model without new dependencies.
Keep edit controls accessible by label and keyboard.
Stay within the harness allowed paths and 12-file change budget.
Run all configured deterministic checks and required Playwright scenarios without console errors.
assumptions: Inline editing is appropriate for the existing task-list interface.
Only one task needs to be edited at a time.
Saving an edit may move or hide a task when its due date or category no longer matches the active view.

sources.summary: Issue requests a way to edit existing tasks when task details need correction or updating.
A separate open pull request for the issue describes editing all task details with save, cancel, validation, persistence, and accessibility behavior.
